title: A low-rank subspace of LLM representations carries most of their brain alignment
summary: Ridge reduced-rank regression found that full linear encoding of neural responses during naturalistic listening is recovered with only 1-3% of LLM embedding dimensions. Across three intracranial and fMRI datasets and six model conditions, these subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, less well, across datasets. The brain-predictive directions differ from the main principal axes of the embeddings.
ai_technology: Autoregressive and masked language models with ridge reduced-rank regression

evidence.tested: Linear encoding of intracranial and fMRI responses from three naturalistic language-listening datasets, with held-out participants.
evidence.unknown: Generalization across datasets is only partial, per the source; other tasks and species are not stated in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: LLM representations are the predictors of neural activity; reduced-rank regression identifies the brain-predictive subspace.
